name: Identity Brand Guidelines
tagline: Formal brand-system deck with navy serif typography, thin table rules, top navigation cells, and alternating white and blue section pages.

palette.description: White pages with steel-blue rules, deep navy typography, and slate-blue chapter dividers.

typography.style: Traditional editorial serif titles with compact sans body labels and spreadsheet-like rule systems.

best_for: Brand guidelines, logo usage, typography rules, visual identity documentation, and formal design-system handoff decks.
avoid_for: Playful consumer launches or emotional image-led storytelling that needs warmth and motion.

source_inspiration.name: Slidesgo Identity Brand Guidelines Kit
source_inspiration.notes: Rebuilt as source-inspired portable HTML/CSS from public visual references; no source asset files are embedded.
